crossRefs.note: That which fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with…
“So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day…
It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.
What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of…
Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word…
For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is…
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

translations.web: Other fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it, and choked it.
translations.bsb: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the seedlings.
translations.kjv: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
translations.asv: And other fell amidst the thorns; and the thorns grew with it, and choked it.
